kaggle_assets_dataset.name: qqp-lstm-whitespace-assets
kaggle_assets_dataset.purpose: Versioned Kaggle input snapshot for the CURRENT word-level/GloVe LSTM experiment. The active notebook is replaced for each subsequent architecture; this is not a multi-notebook archive.
kaggle_assets_dataset.versioning_policy: Publish a new version of this SAME Kaggle dataset for each new whitespace + GloVe experiment. Put exactly one active notebook at the dataset root; remove the prior active notebook from the new version. Older Kaggle dataset versions and the Git repository retain historical snapshots.

active_experiment.architecture: Shared BiLSTM + two-direction custom additive Bahdanau cross-attention + independent attention pooling + binary classifier
active_experiment.purpose: Measure the effect of cross-question token alignment vs. Experiment #1 independent attention pooling under a matched GloVe/word-level protocol.

dataset_root_files.role: Exactly one active source notebook; used for automatic model export, requirements scanning and MLflow notebook capture.
Existing dependency-generation helper used by the notebook.
Latest verified local SQLite snapshot BEFORE this Kaggle training run; copied to writable Kaggle storage.
Metadata about the CURRENT dataset version and its active experiment.

not_in_assets_dataset: Previous experiment notebooks (available in earlier dataset versions / Git)
train.csv (attach a separate existing QQP Kaggle dataset)
glove.6B.100d.txt (attach a separate existing GloVe Kaggle dataset)
model checkpoints and MLflow run artifacts (generated during training)

qqp_dataset.notes: Attach an existing QQP train.csv dataset separately; reproduce or verify EXACTLY Experiment #1's preprocessing and stratified 90/10 split (seed 28). Do not silently use the differently prepared WordPiece split.

glove_embeddings.notes: Read from the attached Kaggle input dataset directly; do not upload it inside the small Experiment #3 assets dataset.

pooling_after_interaction.reason: Keep pooling compatible with Experiment #1 for a controlled comparison.

kaggle_runtime.input_dataset_location: Resolve from /kaggle/input at runtime; do not assume a dataset-version folder structure.
kaggle_runtime.notebook_source_consistency: NOTEBOOK_PATH must point to the exact matching source notebook. Verify it matches the model cells actually executed in Kaggle before exporting model_architecture.py or logging the notebook.

kaggle_mlflow_workflow.import: Copy latest verified database snapshot from this Kaggle dataset to writable /kaggle/working/qqp, preserving historical runs. Check for an existing writable DB before deciding to overwrite.
kaggle_mlflow_workflow.artifact_path_rewrite: Save the original Windows artifact_location, temporarily point the existing LSTM_attention experiment to the Kaggle artifact root, then restore its previous URI and new run/model URIs before backup/export.

export.notes: Use SQLite backup API for a consistent DB snapshot. The export should contain only newly generated artifacts that exist on Kaggle. Import into local MLflow only after checking the local DB has not gained newer runs.

preflight_checks: Verify raw QQP CSV identity and the exact train/validation split match Experiment #1.
Verify pretrained GloVe vectors were actually copied into the vocabulary embedding matrix.
Verify padding, excluded-token masks, and fully masked attention rows are safe and finite.
Verify BiLSTM padding handling and classifier output shape with unequal question lengths.
Verify the exported Python model source matches the exact notebook that Kaggle trains.
Test forward/backward pass, metric computation, and MLflow database import/export before a full training run.
Verify the dataset release contains just the active notebook at its root, not obsolete experiment notebooks.
Confirm the source notebook and requirements helper on Kaggle match those intended for this release.
Record and log the Kaggle dataset version and active notebook hash for reproducibility.
how_to_release_next_version: Select next whitespace/GloVe experiment and update active_experiment, architecture_plan_for_active_experiment, and screening_training_plan_for_active_experiment.
Remove the previous active notebook from the dataset root; add only the new source notebook.
Include the matching requirements.py and a recent verified local MLflow database snapshot.
Update the dataset version/status, notebook filename/hash and external dependencies in manifest.json.
Publish a NEW VERSION of qqp-lstm-whitespace-assets and pin it in the Kaggle run.
After training, export MLflow DB and newly generated artifacts and reconcile them locally.
